# Resource: stripe_file_link

A link that lets anyone download a file. Stripe refuses to change an expired link.

~> Stripe cannot delete a file link, and it serves the file until `expires_at`; set `expires_at` to end one. `terraform destroy`, and a change that would replace the file link, fail at plan time. To stop managing a file link, remove it from the state as [Removing from State](#removing-from-state) shows; it stays in the Stripe account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Files are uploaded to Stripe outside Terraform; refer to one by its ID.
data "stripe_file" "report" {
  id = "file_1AbCdEf"
}

resource "stripe_file_link" "report" {
  file       = data.stripe_file.report.id
  expires_at = "1893456000" # Unix time, 2030-01-01
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `file` - (Required) The ID of the file. The file's `purpose` must be one of the following: `business_icon`, `business_logo`, `customer_signature`, `dispute_evidence`, `finance_report_run`, `financial_account_statement`, `identity_document_downloadable`, `issuing_regulatory_reporting`, `pci_document`, `selfie`, `sigma_scheduled_query`, `tax_document_user_upload`, `terminal_android_apk`, or `terminal_reader_splashscreen`. Changing it fails the plan, because this resource cannot be replaced.

The following arguments are optional:

* `expires_at` - (Optional) The link isn't usable after this future timestamp.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `expired` - Returns if the link is already expired.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `url` - The publicly accessible URL to download the file.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Removing from State

To stop managing a file link whose destroy is refused, remove it from the state without destroying it. In Terraform 1.7 and later, and OpenTofu 1.10 and later, replace the `resource` block with a [`removed` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/removed) and apply:

```terraform
removed {
  from = stripe_file_link.report

  lifecycle {
    destroy = false
  }
}
```

Using `terraform state rm`:

```console
% terraform state rm stripe_file_link.report
```

The file link stays in the Stripe account. Replacing one with `terraform apply -replace` or `terraform taint` fails in the same way, at apply.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a file link using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_file_link.report
  id = "link_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_file_link.report
  identity = {
    id = "link_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the file link.

Using `terraform import`, import a file link using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_file_link.report link_123
```
